page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz, it delivers 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. Memory capacity totals 128 GB RAM, maintaining a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Instruction set features include AVX, AVX-512F, AES, and FMA extension support, complemented by 33 MB of L3 cache. The instance lacks local NVMe SSD storage and includes a baseline network throughput of 6 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark measurements indicate a marked variance between single-threaded and multi-threaded compute capabilities. Single-core tests demonstrate weaker outcomes, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and gzip compression ranking in the bottom quartile of evaluated cloud hardware. In contrast, multi-core metrics register in the middle performance tier, as evidenced by a PassMark CPU score of 23,056.78, a stress-ng multi-core result of 23,516.07, and strong Clang software compilation scores. Uncached memory read bandwidth reaches 87.55 GB/sec, while write bandwidth measures 43.49 GB/sec.

The hardware configuration provides baseline cost efficiency for parallelized general-purpose compute jobs that utilize balanced memory allocations without requiring localized disk storage. Workloads well-aligned with this instance include static web serving, Redis key-value stores, relational database management systems, and small-to-medium large language model prompt processing.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose instance featuring 32 dedicated vCPUs (16 physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8163 processor at 2.5 GHz) and 128 GB of RAM. Operating under the KVM hypervisor, it provides a 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, 33 MB of L3 cache, and support for AVX-512F instructions. Network performance is rated at a 6 Gbps baseline, with no local storage or GPUs included. Benchmark results demonstrate weak single-threaded performance in gzip compression and single-core synthetic tests, but reliable middle-tier throughput in multi-core tasks, including PassMark CPU testing, Clang software compilation, and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression. The server delivers average performance for Redis operations, database tasks, static web serving, and medium-scale LLM prompt processing. This resource profile offers balanced cost efficiency for multi-threaded general-purpose compute, web application backends, and containerized enterprise services.
